A heavy atom at rest decays by emitting an alpha particle. The atomic mass excess, that is the atomic mass minus the mass number expressed as an energy, is 23.67 MeV for the parent atom, 16.37 MeV for the daughter atom and 2.425 MeV for the neutral helium atom. The daughter nucleus has mass number 222 and the alpha particle has mass number 4. Treat the motion of the products non-relativistically and take the ratio of their masses to be the ratio of their mass numbers.
